definitions.rationale: Macro equation expanding the named innerBody proof term to the translated inner-loop statement sequence.
definitions.text:
rule innerBody
    => If(
         Compare(
           Subscript(Name("item1"), Int(0)),
           CmpOp("<", Subscript(Name("item2"), Int(0)))),
         If(
           Compare(
             Call(
               Name("abs"),
               (BinOp(
                 "-",
                 Subscript(Name("item2"), Int(1)),
                 Subscript(Name("item1"), Int(1))),
                .Exprs)),
             CmpOp(
               "<",
               Call(
                 Name("abs"),
                 (BinOp(
                   "-",
                   Subscript(Name("closest"), Int(1)),
                   Subscript(Name("closest"), Int(0))),
                  .Exprs)))),
           If(
             Compare(
               Subscript(Name("item1"), Int(1)),
               CmpOp("<", Subscript(Name("item2"), Int(1)))),
             (Assign(
                Name("closest"),
                TupleExpr(
                  (Subscript(Name("item1"), Int(1)),
                   Subscript(Name("item2"), Int(1)),
                   .Exprs)))
              .Stmts),
             (Assign(
                Name("closest"),
                TupleExpr(
                  (Subscript(Name("item2"), Int(1)),
                   Subscript(Name("item1"), Int(1)),
                   .Exprs)))
              .Stmts)),
           .Stmts),
         .Stmts)

definitions.rationale: Macro equation expanding outerBody to the nested for-loop statement used by the translated program.
definitions.text:
rule outerBody
    => (For(Name("item2"), Name("items"), innerBody) .Stmts)

definitions.rationale: Macro equation defining the named findBody term as the exact translated function body.
definitions.text:
rule findBody
    => If(
         Compare(
           Subscript(Name("numbers"), Int(0)),
           CmpOp("<", Subscript(Name("numbers"), Int(1)))),
         (Assign(
            Name("closest"),
            TupleExpr(
              (Subscript(Name("numbers"), Int(0)),
               Subscript(Name("numbers"), Int(1)),
               .Exprs)))
          .Stmts),
         (Assign(
            Name("closest"),
            TupleExpr(
              (Subscript(Name("numbers"), Int(1)),
               Subscript(Name("numbers"), Int(0)),
               .Exprs)))
          .Stmts))
       Assign(
         Name("items"),
         Call(
           Name("list"),
           (Call(Name("enumerate"), (Name("numbers"), .Exprs)), .Exprs)))
       Assign(Name("item1"), Subscript(Name("items"), Int(0)))
       Assign(Name("item2"), Subscript(Name("items"), Int(0)))
       For(Name("item1"), Name("items"), outerBody)
       Return(Name("closest"))
       .Stmts

definitions.rationale: Macro equation defining solutionModule as the translated import and function declaration.
definitions.text:
rule solutionModule
    => Module(
         ImportFrom("typing", ("List", "Tuple", .ParamNames))
         FuncDef(
           "find_closest_elements",
           Params(("numbers", .ParamNames)),
           findBody)
         .Stmts)

definitions.rationale: Base equation for the allFloatVS structural recognizer on an empty value sequence.
definitions.text: rule allFloatVS(.ValSeq) => true

definitions.rationale: Recursive equation defining allFloatVS on a nonempty sequence, with strict descent on the tail.
definitions.text:
rule allFloatVS(vCons(V:Val, REST:ValSeq))
    => (V ==K floatProjection(V)) andBool allFloatVS(REST)

definitions.rationale: Projection equation defining floatProjection on values of sort Float.
definitions.text: rule floatProjection(F:Float) => F

definitions.rationale: Base equation for the allFloatItems structural recognizer on an empty value sequence.
definitions.text: rule allFloatItems(.ValSeq) => true

definitions.rationale: Recursive equation defining canonical enumerated float items, descending on the sequence tail.
definitions.text:
rule allFloatItems(vCons(V:Val, REST:ValSeq))
    => ( V
         ==K
         tuple(
           vCons(
             itemIndex(V),
             vCons(itemFloat(V), .ValSeq))) )
       andBool allFloatItems(REST)

definitions.rationale: Structural projection equation defining itemIndex for canonical Int-Float tuple values.
definitions.text:
rule itemIndex(
         tuple(vCons(I:Int, vCons(_:Float, .ValSeq))))
    => I

definitions.rationale: Structural projection equation defining itemFloat for canonical Int-Float tuple values.
definitions.text:
rule itemFloat(
         tuple(vCons(_:Int, vCons(F:Float, .ValSeq))))
    => F

definitions.rationale: True-branch equation defining orderedFirst under floatLt.
definitions.text:
rule orderedFirst(X:Float, Y:Float) => X
    requires floatLt(X, Y)

definitions.rationale: Complementary false-branch equation completing the definition of orderedFirst.
definitions.text:
rule orderedFirst(X:Float, Y:Float) => Y
    requires notBool floatLt(X, Y)

definitions.rationale: True-branch equation defining orderedSecond under floatLt.
definitions.text:
rule orderedSecond(X:Float, Y:Float) => Y
    requires floatLt(X, Y)

definitions.rationale: Complementary false-branch equation completing the definition of orderedSecond.
definitions.text:
rule orderedSecond(X:Float, Y:Float) => X
    requires notBool floatLt(X, Y)

definitions.rationale: Equation defining the candidateWins Boolean summary from indices and float-distance primitives.
definitions.text:
rule candidateWins(ITEM1:Val, ITEM2:Val, A:Float, B:Float)
    => itemIndex(ITEM1) <Int itemIndex(ITEM2)
       andBool floatLt(
                 absF(subF(itemFloat(ITEM2), itemFloat(ITEM1))),
                 absF(subF(B, A)))

definitions.rationale: Non-winning branch equation defining the first accumulator component.
definitions.text:
rule stepFirst(ITEM1:Val, ITEM2:Val, A:Float, B:Float)
    => A
    requires notBool candidateWins(ITEM1, ITEM2, A, B)

definitions.rationale: Winning and ordered branch equation defining the first accumulator component.
definitions.text:
rule stepFirst(ITEM1:Val, ITEM2:Val, A:Float, B:Float)
    => itemFloat(ITEM1)
    requires candidateWins(ITEM1, ITEM2, A, B)
     andBool floatLt(itemFloat(ITEM1), itemFloat(ITEM2))

definitions.rationale: Winning and reverse-ordered branch equation completing the definition of the first accumulator component.
definitions.text:
rule stepFirst(ITEM1:Val, ITEM2:Val, A:Float, B:Float)
    => itemFloat(ITEM2)
    requires candidateWins(ITEM1, ITEM2, A, B)
     andBool notBool floatLt(itemFloat(ITEM1), itemFloat(ITEM2))

definitions.rationale: Non-winning branch equation defining the second accumulator component.
definitions.text:
rule stepSecond(ITEM1:Val, ITEM2:Val, A:Float, B:Float)
    => B
    requires notBool candidateWins(ITEM1, ITEM2, A, B)

definitions.rationale: Winning and ordered branch equation defining the second accumulator component.
definitions.text:
rule stepSecond(ITEM1:Val, ITEM2:Val, A:Float, B:Float)
    => itemFloat(ITEM2)
    requires candidateWins(ITEM1, ITEM2, A, B)
     andBool floatLt(itemFloat(ITEM1), itemFloat(ITEM2))

definitions.rationale: Winning and reverse-ordered branch equation completing the definition of the second accumulator component.
definitions.text:
rule stepSecond(ITEM1:Val, ITEM2:Val, A:Float, B:Float)
    => itemFloat(ITEM1)
    requires candidateWins(ITEM1, ITEM2, A, B)
     andBool notBool floatLt(itemFloat(ITEM1), itemFloat(ITEM2))

definitions.rationale: Empty-sequence base equation for the innerFirst fold summary.
definitions.text: rule innerFirst(_ITEM1:Val, .ValSeq, A:Float, _B:Float) => A

definitions.rationale: Recursive equation defining innerFirst with strict structural descent through the remaining items.
definitions.text:
rule innerFirst(
         ITEM1:Val,
         vCons(ITEM2:Val, REST:ValSeq),
         A:Float,
         B:Float)
    => innerFirst(
         ITEM1,
         REST,
         stepFirst(ITEM1, ITEM2, A, B),
         stepSecond(ITEM1, ITEM2, A, B))

definitions.rationale: Empty-sequence base equation for the innerSecond fold summary.
definitions.text: rule innerSecond(_ITEM1:Val, .ValSeq, _A:Float, B:Float) => B

definitions.rationale: Recursive equation defining innerSecond with strict structural descent through the remaining items.
definitions.text:
rule innerSecond(
         ITEM1:Val,
         vCons(ITEM2:Val, REST:ValSeq),
         A:Float,
         B:Float)
    => innerSecond(
         ITEM1,
         REST,
         stepFirst(ITEM1, ITEM2, A, B),
         stepSecond(ITEM1, ITEM2, A, B))

definitions.rationale: Empty-sequence base equation for the outerFirst fold summary.
definitions.text: rule outerFirst(.ValSeq, _ALL:ValSeq, A:Float, _B:Float) => A

definitions.rationale: Recursive equation defining outerFirst by one inner fold and strict descent through the outer sequence.
definitions.text:
rule outerFirst(
         vCons(ITEM1:Val, REST:ValSeq),
         ALL:ValSeq,
         A:Float,
         B:Float)
    => outerFirst(
         REST,
         ALL,
         innerFirst(ITEM1, ALL, A, B),
         innerSecond(ITEM1, ALL, A, B))

definitions.rationale: Empty-sequence base equation for the outerSecond fold summary.
definitions.text: rule outerSecond(.ValSeq, _ALL:ValSeq, _A:Float, B:Float) => B

definitions.rationale: Recursive equation defining outerSecond by one inner fold and strict descent through the outer sequence.
definitions.text:
rule outerSecond(
         vCons(ITEM1:Val, REST:ValSeq),
         ALL:ValSeq,
         A:Float,
         B:Float)
    => outerSecond(
         REST,
         ALL,
         innerFirst(ITEM1, ALL, A, B),
         innerSecond(ITEM1, ALL, A, B))

definitions.rationale: Empty-sequence base equation defining lastItem as the prior accumulator.
definitions.text: rule lastItem(.ValSeq, OLD:Val) => OLD

definitions.rationale: Recursive equation defining lastItem with strict descent and replacement by the current head.
definitions.text:
rule lastItem(vCons(V:Val, REST:ValSeq), _OLD:Val)
    => lastItem(REST, V)

proved_derived_lemmas.rationale: Reusable inner-loop transition whose exact reachability statement is first proved as CONNECTION-SPEC.inner-loop-connection against bridge-free VERIFICATION-BASE; prove.sh only compiles VERIFICATION containing this rule afterward.
proved_derived_lemmas.text:
rule <k>
         #loop(list(REST:ValSeq), Name("item2"), innerBody)
         => .K
         ...
       </k>
       <env> 1 </env>
       <scopes>
         -1 |-> scope(
                "len"        |-> builtinV("len")
                "set"        |-> builtinV("set")
                "sum"        |-> builtinV("sum")
                "abs"        |-> builtinV("abs")
                "min"        |-> builtinV("min")
                "max"        |-> builtinV("max")
                "ord"        |-> builtinV("ord")
                "chr"        |-> builtinV("chr")
                "range"      |-> builtinV("range")
                "all"        |-> builtinV("all")
                "any"        |-> builtinV("any")
                "zip"        |-> builtinV("zip")
                "isinstance" |-> builtinV("isinstance")
                "sorted"     |-> builtinV("sorted")
                "list"       |-> builtinV("list")
                "round"      |-> builtinV("round")
                "bin"        |-> builtinV("bin")
                "enumerate"  |-> builtinV("enumerate")
                "map"        |-> builtinV("map")
                "eval"       |-> builtinV("eval")
                "int"        |-> typeV("int")
                "str"        |-> typeV("str")
                "float"      |-> typeV("float"),
                root)
         0 |-> scope(
                "find_closest_elements"
                  |-> closureVal(
                        ("numbers", .ParamNames),
                        findBody,
                        0),
                parent(-1))
         1 |-> scope(
                "numbers" |-> _NUMBERS:Val
                "items"   |-> _ITEMSREF:Val
                "item1"   |-> ITEM1:Val
                "item2"   |-> (OLD2:Val => lastItem(REST, OLD2))
                "closest" |->
                  ( tuple(vCons(A:Float, vCons(B:Float, .ValSeq)))
                    =>
                    tuple(
                      vCons(
                        innerFirst(ITEM1, REST, A, B),
                        vCons(
                          innerSecond(ITEM1, REST, A, B),
                          .ValSeq))) ),
                parent(0))
       </scopes>
    requires ITEM1
       ==K tuple(
             vCons(
               itemIndex(ITEM1),
               vCons(itemFloat(ITEM1), .ValSeq)))
     andBool allFloatItems(REST)
    [priority(40)]

source_rules.rationale: Guarded simplification relating the imported applyIndex operation at index 0 to itemIndex; it is an added mathematical fact rather than a defining equation for applyIndex.
source_rules.text:
rule applyIndex(V:Val, 0) => itemIndex(V)
    requires V
      ==K tuple(
            vCons(
              itemIndex(V),
              vCons(itemFloat(V), .ValSeq)))
    [simplification]
